newsitem.title: USA: Express Scripts sees membership growth.
newsitem.headline: Express Scripts sees membership growth.

text.p: Express Scripts Inc said Friday it expects its total membership to continue to grow despite two health maintenance organizations allowing their contracts to expire at the first of the year.
Express said two HMO clients, representing a total of more than 500,000 members, told the company they will not renew their contracts on January 1, 1997.
"The company expects this loss to be more than offset by new members anticipated to be receiving services by January 1, 1997," Express said in a statement.
Express said it posted a net increase in membership in the third quarter despite the loss of more than 340,000 members due to consolidation affecting several HMO clients.
Express reported third quarter net earnings of $0.42 a share versus $0.31 for the period last year.
